none: PAS NLM-62EDF7: Roman Coin: Denarius of Julia Domna

Base silver with silver wash coin. Denarius of Julia Domna (193-217), probably mint of Rome, issue of 196-211, Sear volume 2 no. 6601, citing RIC volume 4 part 1 no. 574. Obverse description: Bust coiffed and draped right. Obverse inscription: IVLIA AVGVSTA. Reverse description: Pietas standing facing both arms raised in prayer beside altar. Reverse inscription: [PIE]TAS PVBLICA. Diameter: 19.2mm, Weight: 2.39gms, die axis: 12
